headlines.title_en: Bank of France: Expects French Q3 GDP growth of 0.2%
headlines.summary_en: France's central bank said the economy is expected to maintain growth momentum this quarter, with a survey showing Q3 GDP growth of 0.2%, unchanged from the previous quarter and slightly above market expectations of 0.1%. The Bank of France said economic activity will continue to be driven by the services sector, including transport, information and communications. Meanwhile, manufacturing rebounded in August. Looking ahead, the energy sector is expected to continue expanding, but construction may decline further due to fewer public project contracts. The Bank of France warned that the economic outlook still faces 'significant uncertainty,' with risks stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and extreme weather. A survey of 8,500 companies by the Bank of France showed that raw material costs and selling price increases slowed in July, suggesting that the pass-through of spring input cost increases to end prices may be nearing completion. The Bank of France's assessment indicates that the French economy presents a mixed picture ahead of the presidential election.

headlines.title: 法国央行预计第三季度经济保持增长势头
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。

headlines.title_en: Bank of France expects continued growth momentum in Q3
headlines.summary_en: France's central bank said the economy is expected to maintain growth momentum this quarter, supported by growth in key sectors and cooling inflation. The Bank of France, citing a monthly business survey on Tuesday, said it expects Q3 GDP growth of 0.2%. That would match the previous quarter and be slightly above the 0.1% predicted by analysts in a Bloomberg survey. The Bank of France said economic activity will continue to be led by the services sector, including transport, information and communications, while manufacturing rebounded in August. Looking ahead, the energy sector is expected to expand, but construction may decline further due to fewer public contracts. Meanwhile, the Bank of France warned that the economy still faces 'significant uncertainty,' citing 'geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and weather conditions until the end of summer, when new heatwaves may still occur.'

headlines.title_en: Bank of France expects Q3 economic growth of 0.2%
headlines.summary_en: [Bank of France expects 0.2% Q3 economic growth] On August 11, local time, the Bank of France released its latest economic survey report, forecasting that France's GDP will grow 0.2% quarter-on-quarter in Q3 this year, unchanged from Q2. The Bank of France said Q3 growth is expected to be mainly supported by market services activity. In July, French industrial and market services activity continued to grow, while construction activity remained broadly stable.

headlines.title: 巴克莱：美债对价格敏感型买家的依赖显著上升，料使收益率维持高位
headlines.summary: 巴克莱表示，美国国债买家结构正在转向更注重价值的共同基金、家庭和其他私人投资者，这一变化帮助推动30年期美债收益率升至数十年来高位。策略师Demi Hu和Anshul Pradan认为，只要通胀持续存在，这些买家就会要求越来越高的补偿，才愿意持有长期债券。“美国国债的买家基础已经发生变化。”自2022年美联储开始缩减持仓以来，外国央行和美联储等官方部门的需求持续减弱，使得“私人投资者成为吸收新增供应的边际买家”。

headlines.title_en: Barclays: Rising reliance on price-sensitive buyers for U.S. Treasuries likely to keep yields elevated
headlines.summary_en: Barclays said the buyer base for U.S. Treasuries is shifting toward more value-focused mutual funds, households and other private investors, a change that has helped push 30-year Treasury yields to multi-decade highs. Strategists Demi Hu and Anshul Pradan believe that as long as inflation persists, these buyers will demand increasingly higher compensation to hold long-dated bonds. 'The buyer base for U.S. Treasuries has changed.' Since the Fed began shrinking its holdings in 2022, demand from official sectors such as foreign central banks and the Fed has weakened steadily, making 'private investors the marginal buyers absorbing new supply.'

headlines.summary_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed down 2.94% at 6,532.41, retreating from its highest closing level since June 2 at 6,730.14. Among popular Chinese ADRs, Tencent Music initially closed down 11.9%, Bilibili fell 5.2%, New Oriental fell 4.6%, NetEase fell 4.1%, Canadian Solar rose 1.8%, GDS rose 3.9%, and Zai Lab rose 10.3%. Among ETFs, the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (KWEB) closed down 3.54%, and the China Technology Index ETF (CQQQ) closed down 1.97%. Xtrackers Harvest CSI 50 (ASHS) closed up 1.19%, Deutsche Bank Harvest CSI 300 Index ETF (ASHR) closed down 0.80%, and MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF (EMXC) closed up 0.96%.

headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率跌超2个基点
headlines.summary: 周二（8月11日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌1.63个基点，报4.6904%，北京时间18:00-21:46持续走低，从4.73%附近下挫至4.6659%刷新日低。 两年期美债收益率跌2.10个基点，报4.22%；30年期美债收益率跌0.86个基点，报5.2424%。 2/10年期美债收益率利差涨0.479个基点，报+46.826个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率跌0.27个基点，至2.4274%；两年期TIPS收益率涨0.18个基点，至2.0357%；30年期TIPS收益率跌0.13个基点，至3.0183%。

headlines.title_en: U.S. 2-year Treasury yield fell more than 2 basis points
headlines.summary_en: On Tuesday (August 11) at the New York close, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 1.63 basis points to 4.6904%, declining steadily from 18:00 to 21:46 Beijing time, dropping from around 4.73% to a session low of 4.6659%. The 2-year Treasury yield fell 2.10 basis points to 4.22%; the 30-year Treasury yield fell 0.86 basis points to 5.2424%. The 2/10-year Treasury yield spread rose 0.479 basis points to +46.826 basis points. The 10-year TIPS yield fell 0.27 basis points to 2.4274%; the 2-year TIPS yield rose 0.18 basis points to 2.0357%; the 30-year TIPS yield fell 0.13 basis points to 3.0183%.

headlines.title: 德国两年期国债收益率跌2个基点

headlines.title_en: Germany's 2-year Treasury yield fell 2 basis points
headlines.summary_en: On Tuesday (August 11) at the European close, the German 10-year bund yield fell 2.0 basis points to 3.158%, trading in a range of 3.208%-3.144% intraday, with a 'higher open' at 14:28 Beijing time and persistent narrow high-level fluctuations, declining steadily from 18:00 and hitting a session low at 22:24. The 2-year bund yield fell 1.2 basis points to 2.789%, trading in a range of 2.898%-2.774% intraday, with Bloomberg data showing a brief spike at 14:28 before quickly falling back to around 2.820%; the 30-year bund yield fell 1.7 basis points to 3.655%. The 2/10-year bund yield spread fell 0.826 basis points to +36.706 basis points, with abnormal volatility at 14:28—plunging from around +37 basis points to +28.4

headlines.title: 英债收益率普遍跌超2个基点
headlines.summary: 周二（8月11日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率跌2.1个基点，报4.967%，北京时间16:16涨至5.050%刷新日高，最后逐步下挫、21:49刷新日低至4.939%。 两年期英债收益率跌2.7个基点，报4.314%，日内交投区间为4.401%-4.280%。 30年期英债收益率跌2个基点，50年期英债收益率跌2个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差涨0.463个基点，报+64.992个基点。

headlines.title_en: UK bond yields broadly fell more than 2 basis points
headlines.summary_en: On Tuesday (August 11) at the European close, the UK 10-year gilt yield fell 2.1 basis points to 4.967%, rising to a session high of 5.050% at 16:16 Beijing time, then declining gradually and hitting a session low of 4.939% at 21:49. The 2-year gilt yield fell 2.7 basis points to 4.314%, trading in a range of 4.401%-4.280% intraday. The 30-year gilt yield fell 2 basis points, and the 50-year gilt yield fell 2 basis points. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread rose 0.463 basis points to +64.992 basis points.

headlines.title: 财达证券研究所“引援”再下一城，解运亮出任首席经济学家
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。
